title: Feature-Gap Audit — canonicalize 64 PRISM features absent from the task queue
brief: Surfaces and registers as roadmap units the substantial PRISM features that were absent from the task queue at the time of the 2026-05-17 /forge-audit-v2 6-agent scan. Sources: (a) unwired-engine backlog per domain (674 unwired, ~595 absent from any roadmap), (b) v8.89 extracted/ monolith digest=0 features, (c) JM-DIE / Resources corpus-ingestion gaps not covered by RES-MS0-27. Each unit is domain-tagged so allocate-domains-to-slots.mjs routes it to the owning slot (alpha=mill...mike=misc, golf=database). Each unit is a proposal — duplicationGuardEngine.mustCheckBeforeCreating() before any /forge-triple. Advisory, mustHumanVerify.

units.title: Re-modularize PRISM_ADVANCED_FEED_OPTIMIZER from v8.89 monolith
units.ship_notes: R8 dedup-preflight: the v8.89 monolith extracted/engines/optimization/PRISM_ADVANCED_FEED_OPTIMIZER.js is 59 lines — calculateChipThinning (approximate CTF=1/sqrt(1-(1-2ae/D)^2)) + compensateFeed + optimizeFeedProfile(toolpath). 100% subsumed, more rigorously, by already-wired engines: EngagementAdaptiveFeedEngine.chipThinningFactor() (3 models: simplified/martellotti/exact θ=acos(1-2ae/D) — strictly superior to the monolith's single approximate form; feed compensation at L227) + FeedOptimizationEngine (8-level aggressiveness + toolpath chip-thinning compensation) + AdvancedChipThicknessEngine.chipThinningFactorLookup (wired via prism_calc, calcDispatcher L2725). Existing coverage: ChipThinningCompensationEngine.test.ts. Building PRISM_ADVANCED_FEED_OPTIMIZER would (a) THROW in duplicationGuardEngine.mustCheckBeforeCreating and (b) REGRESS quality (approx vs exact formula). Same class as the FEATURE-GAP-AUDIT CAD dedup-wins (reference_feature_gap_audit_cad_dedup_wins_2026_05_18) — 'Re-modularize PRISM_X' units must Glob engines/ first; digest=0 'absent' is digest-staleness, not a real gap. No code shipped — close-out is the dedup determination.
